message: Thanks for all the excellent suggestions. Definitely some of the Brandenburgs, Brahms, Bernstein's Stravinsky, Dvorak, and Profokiev, but I'm actually much more partial to the second movement of Beethoven's 7th than the first -- maybe just a taste thing? I've got Bernstein conducting Mahler's 4th, and Mehta conducting the 5th, but I'm not familiar with the Williams -- I'll have to seek it out. At the risk of cliché, I'm also thinking of Furtwängler & Menuhin's wonderful rendition of Mendelssohn's violin concerto, and maybe some of Rostropovich's Tschaikovsky, both with the Berlin Philharmonic. The compilation is, after all, intended as something of a primer or introduction.
